minutes.headline: Open Space Committee will meet the select board on the 16th to discuss giving two Lake Shirley parcels to Parks; residents opposed.
minutes.summary: The ad hoc committee approved its October 2023 minutes, then went through missing-minutes records requested by the assistant town clerk. It planned who would attend the January 16 select board meeting on its recommendation to turn the Parmenter Road and Reservoir Road parcels over to the Parks Commission. A member gave a Conservation Commission grants and volunteers update. Two residents spoke against added public access to Lake Shirley.

public_comment.topic: Opposes the Parks Commission taking over additional land on Lake Shirley and opposes added uncontrolled public access. Prefers the land stay general municipal land.
Opposes it for reasons of public safety, lake maintenance, handicapped access, traffic, conservation, weeds, trash and parking.
Gave his name and address for the record; no comment was captured.

votes.motion: Accept the October 25, 2023 minutes as distributed.

budget_items.topic: Snow Riders sponsored grant, awarded in 22
budget_items.what_was_said: The grant covers trail projects on conservation lands. Gravel has been added at the Lane property and Smalltown Forest trail work is next.

budget_items.topic: Conservation Commission grant for parking engineering drawings
budget_items.what_was_said: A grant awarded in 2023 funds engineering drawings for parking areas in three conservation areas. The group is waiting on the executed state grant contract before hiring a consultant.
A resident said Lake Shirley residents voluntarily support lake maintenance and that waterfront properties saw a significant tax increase.

decisions.decision: The chair will send out the assistant town clerk's list of past meetings again so members can check their calendars for 2021 and 2022 meetings and minutes.
The chair will ask Heather to post the January 16 select board attendance as a joint meeting, because four or more members may attend.
Anna will meet Paula bertran on Tuesday at the library for her research on the parcels. Paula may attend the select board meeting as a resident.
The next meeting is set for the 14th, subject to enough agenda items. The one after is March 13.

what_happened.line: The ad hoc Open Space Committee planned attendance at the January 16 select board meeting, where it will discuss its recommendation to turn two Lake Shirley parcels over to the Parks Commission.
Two residents spoke against the Parks Commission taking additional Lake Shirley land and against added public access; no vote was taken on the recommendation.
The committee approved its October 2023 minutes and went through missing past minutes requested by the assistant town clerk, with the chair to resend the list of past meetings.
A member reported that a Conservation Commission grant for parking engineering drawings is waiting on the executed state grant contract before a consultant is hired.
The next meeting is set for the 14th, subject to enough agenda items, and the one after for March 13.

why_it_matters: Whether the Parmenter Road and Reservoir Road parcels move to the Parks Commission changes who manages that land and how the public can reach Lake Shirley, and residents will hear it at the select board's January 16 meeting.
The committee's own minutes for 2021 and 2022 are incomplete, so the record of its past work is still being reassembled.
